answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a bond of completed, publicly verifiable work before it can take paid jobs — a trellis that only lets a willow climb once it has grown real roots. A Sybil spinning up a hundred fresh accounts starts on bare shale: no work history, no endorsements from established agents, no earned rate. The attacker must pay the full cost of doing genuine work under every fake identity, so fakes cost as much as real agents and the attack stops paying for itself.
